name: la6176-la2a-drum-punch
description: Punch-enhancing drum glue using the UADx LA-6176's LA-2A (opto) dynamics mode. On percussive material the slow, program-dependent opto attack lets the transients THROUGH while leveling the sustain/ring, so crest goes UP (measured: pk3 13.6, pk6 15.2, pk9 18.2 vs 14.2 dry) — the opposite of the 1176's fast FET grab. A little high shelf +3 @7k adds snap/presence. Clean Line preamp (no drive). MEASURE on the Watercolors 8-bar loop; expect crest to RISE and the body to glue.
intended_for: a drum bus / room / loop that wants smooth opto glue that PRESERVES (even exaggerates) punch — and any source where you want the LA-2A's gentle, program-dependent leveling instead of the 1176's bite
plugin_build: uaudio_la_6176.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the 'UAD LA-6176 Channel Strip.component' twin passes through, do not use it). 26 enum params; dyn_mode/la2a_ratio + the string switches need this setattr harness, not the float dict.
notes: LA-2A ON DRUMS RAISES CREST. Slow opto attack misses the fast drum transient (peak survives) while it levels the sustained ring -> RMS drops -> crest rises. pk_red is the amount/drive into the opto: pk3 -> crest 13.6, pk6 -> 15.2, pk9 -> 18.2. Use higher pk_red for MORE punch enhancement, not less.

On SUSTAINED sources (vocals, bass, pads, the 2-bus) the same opto clamps hard and program-dependently -> smooth, transparent leveling (heavy GR on steady tones in our test). It is the 'set it and forget it' leveler, the 1176 is the 'grab it' compressor.
la2a_ratio: Comp vs Limit -> Limit is a higher internal ratio (slightly more GR / firmer ceiling). la2a_gain is the makeup (the harness peak-normalizes anyway).
The 1176_* params are inert here (dyn_mode=LA2A) but set to sane defaults so a later switch to '1176' is predictable.
A/B loudness-matched: a crest rise can read as 'more dynamic/punchy', so confirm it is not just a level/EQ illusion.
